full_judgment:
"7. Execution of decisions and orders of a Tribunal—A Tribunal shall, for the purpose of execution of its decisions or orders, follow, as far as practicable, the provisions of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (V of 1908) relating to the execution of a decree." 

 11. Under the provisions of Rule 7 of the Administrative Tribunal Rules, 1982 the Administrative Tribunal, we think, can execute, auctioning as an executing Court, its own decisions or orders and also the decisions or orders of the Administrative Appellate Tribunal following the provisions of Civil Procedure Code relating to execution of a decree. The petitioner therefore has a remedy under Rule 7 of the Administrative Tribunal Rules, 1982 before the Administrative Tribunal to implement the decision or order of the Administrative Appellate Tribunal dated 23.4.87.
